{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=July 2024}} {{Infobox college sports team season |year=2024–25 |team=Kansas State Wildcats |sport=Basketball |image=Kansas State Wildcats wordmark.svg |image_size=250 |conference=Big 12 Conference |division= |short_conf=Big 12 |CoachRank= |APRank= |record= 16–17 |conf_record= 9–11 |head_coach=[[Jerome Tang]] |hc_year=3rd |assoc_coach=[[Ulric Maligi]] |ahc_year=3rd |asst_coach1=Jareem Dowling |asst_coach2=Rodney Perry |stadium=[[Bramlage Coliseum]] |champion= |tourney= |tourney_result= }} {{2024–25 Big 12 men's basketball standings}} The '''2024–25 Kansas State Wildcats men's basketball team''' represented [[Kansas State University]] in the [[2024–25 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]], their 122nd basketball season. The Wildcats were led by third-year head coach [[Jerome Tang]] and played their home games in [[Bramlage Coliseum]] in [[Manhattan, Kansas]] as members of the [[Big 12 Conference]]. The finished the season 16–17, 9–11 in [[2024–25 Big 12 Conference men's basketball season|Big 12 play]] to finish a tie for ninth place. As the No. 10 seed in the [[2025 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 tournament]], they defeated [[2024–25 Arizona State Sun Devils men's basketball team|Arizona State]] before losing to [[2024–25 Baylor Bears men's basketball team|Baylor]]. ==Previous season== The [[2023–24 Kansas State Wildcats men's basketball team|Wildcats]] finished the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2023–24 season]] 19–15, 8–10 in [[2023–24 Big 12 Conference men's basketball season|Big 12 play]] to finish in a tie for ninth place. They lost in the Quarterfinals of the [[2024 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 tournament]] to [[2023–24 Iowa State Cyclones men's basketball team|Iowa State]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2024 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]] in the Villanova Bracket.
